meta_title: P J K Plastering | Expert Plasterer Leeds
meta_description: P J K Plastering in Leeds offers professional plastering, skimming, and rendering. Fast, reliable service. Call 07791 543750 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Cracked plaster, damp patches, or a room that needs skimming? We arrive on time, leave your home clean, and finish the job right.
services_subhead: From emergency crack repairs to full room skimming, we handle all interior and exterior plastering work.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional finish to walls and ceilings. We prepare, plaster, and skim to a level you won't find shortcuts on — perfect before decoration.

services.title: Crack Repair & Patching
services.desc: Hairline cracks or large damage — we isolate the cause, fill, and blend seamlessly. No quick fixes that fail in six months.

services.title: Damp & Water Damage Repairs
services.desc: Wet plaster needs proper drying and remedial work, not just a coat of paint. We rebuild affected areas to prevent mould and further damage.

services.title: Exterior Rendering & Roughcast
services.desc: Weather-resistant external finish to protect your brickwork. We use quality mixes that last and won't crack or erode prematurely.

services.title: Artexed Ceiling Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of old artex with full dust containment, followed by new plaster finish. We handle hazard assessments and proper disposal.

services.title: New Build & Extensions
services.desc: Site work on new structures and extensions — initial plaster, floating and setting, skimming, and finishes to building control standard.

about_pullquote: I do the work right the first time — no comebacks, no headaches.
about_para_1: P J K Plastering has been serving Leeds and Morley for nearly two decades. Started as a one-man operation, we've built a reputation for showing up when we say we will, leaving a tidy site, and finishing jobs that other plasterers have botched. We pride ourselves on understanding that plastering is the foundation for every decorated room — rush it or cut corners, and the customer pays for it later.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we communicate clearly, price fairly, and take pride in the finish. We're not the cheapest, but we're the ones who'll spend an extra hour getting the skirting line perfect or re-floating a ceiling because it's worth it. Word-of-mouth keeps our diary full, and that's how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About P J K

reviews.text: Had three rooms skimmed before we decorated. Paul turned up at 7:30 as promised, got stuck in, and left the place spotless. Finish was brilliant — no need to touch it up. Will definitely ring him again when we do the upstairs.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called about a damp patch in the bedroom corner. Paul explained what had caused it, didn't just slap plaster over it, and did the whole wall. Cost more than I expected but it's held up perfectly six months on. That's worth paying for.
reviews.author: Clare M.

reviews.text: Emergency artex removal and new plaster before our kitchen extension inspection. Paul fitted us in at short notice, worked fast without being sloppy, and the inspector signed it off first time. Top bloke, would use again.
reviews.author: Marcus L.
